stem: In the 1630s, Thomas Hooker and Roger Williams disagreed with the religious leaders of Massachusetts. These disagreements were resolved when Hooker and Williams —

options.label: A
options.text: left Massachusetts and established new colonies

options.label: B
options.text: founded new political parties in the Massachusetts Bay area

options.label: C
options.text: petitioned Parliament to revise the Massachusetts Bay charter

options.label: D
options.text: left Massachusetts and explored the Mississippi Valley
